name: Digital Droid Bridge
install:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ -f .cursor/install.sh ]]; then bash .cursor/install.sh
elif [[ -f digital-droid-bridge/.cursor/install.sh ]]; then bash digital-droid-bridge/.cursor/install.sh
elif [[ -f /workspace/digital-droid-bridge/.cursor/install.sh ]]; then bash /workspace/digital-droid-bridge/.cursor/install.sh
elif [[ -f /agent/repos/digital-droid-bridge/.cursor/install.sh ]]; then bash /agent/repos/digital-droid-bridge/.cursor/install.sh
else echo "digital-droid-bridge install.sh not found from $(pwd)" >&2; exit 1
fi
start:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ -f .cursor/start.sh ]]; then bash .cursor/start.sh
elif [[ -f digital-droid-bridge/.cursor/start.sh ]]; then bash digital-droid-bridge/.cursor/start.sh
elif [[ -f /workspace/digital-droid-bridge/.cursor/start.sh ]]; then bash /workspace/digital-droid-bridge/.cursor/start.sh
elif [[ -f /agent/repos/digital-droid-bridge/.cursor/start.sh ]]; then bash /agent/repos/digital-droid-bridge/.cursor/start.sh
else echo "digital-droid-bridge start.sh not found from $(pwd)" >&2; exit 1
fi
